text.zh-CN: 距肛4 cm糜烂性肿块伴狭窄，活检中分化腺癌。
text.en: An ulcerated narrowing mass4 cm from the anus; biopsy showed moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 肿瘤突破直肠壁侵犯膀胱，膀胱内肠内容物；膀胱颈/三角区约6×6 cm肿物，多发盆腔淋巴结。
text.en: Tumour extended through the rectal wall into the bladder, with intestinal content in the bladder; an approximately6×6 cm bladder neck/trigone mass and multiple pelvic nodes.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 胸片、腹部超声未见明确远处转移；初始临床分期T4bN2M0，伴瘘、不全梗阻、出血和感染。
text.en: Chest radiograph and abdominal ultrasound showed no definite distant metastasis; initial clinical stageT4bN2M0 with fistula, partial obstruction, bleeding and infection.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 血常规、生化和肿瘤标志物原文报告正常，尿白细胞++。
text.en: Blood count, chemistry and tumour markers were reported normal; urinary leucocytes++.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 横结肠转流后症状缓解，再接受新辅助放化疗；影像缩小后行全盆腔脏器切除及输尿管皮肤造口。标本无癌，淋巴结0/22，报告病理完全缓解；早期术后MRI无明确病灶。原文建议后续化疗，但未证实完成或长期无复发。
text.en: Transverse colostomy relieved symptoms, followed by neoadjuvant chemoradiation. After radiological regression, total pelvic exenteration and ureterocutaneous diversion were performed. No cancer remained in the specimen and nodes were0/22, a pathological complete response; early postoperative MRI showed no definite lesion. Further chemotherapy was recommended, but completion and long-term recurrence status were not documented.

text.zh-CN: 直肠腺癌跨器官侵犯形成直肠膀胱瘘
text.en: Rectal adenocarcinoma invading the bladder with a rectovesical fistula

feedback.zh-CN: 影像中的膀胱内肠内容物与病理、粪尿一致。
feedback.en: Intravesical bowel content matches the biopsy and faecaluria.

text.zh-CN: 肿瘤标志物正常就不是癌
text.en: Normal tumour markers exclude cancer

text.zh-CN: 膀胱肿物必为独立原发膀胱癌
text.en: The bladder mass must be an independent bladder primary

feedback.zh-CN: 连贯的侵犯路径支持直肠原发。
feedback.en: The contiguous invasion supports a rectal origin.

prompt.zh-CN: 本例梗阻、瘘和感染下如何组织治疗？
prompt.en: How should treatment be organised with obstruction, fistula and infection?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 先处理污染和梗阻风险，由多学科规划转流、肿瘤治疗及后续切除评估
text.en: Address contamination/obstruction and use a multidisciplinary plan for diversion, oncological therapy and reassessment for resection

feedback.zh-CN: 症状控制可为后续治疗创造条件，具体方式需个体化。
feedback.en: Controlling complications can enable subsequent therapy; the approach is individualised.

text.zh-CN: 不处理感染，立即照抄原放化疗剂量
text.en: Copy the historical chemoradiation dose without addressing infection

feedback.zh-CN: 感染及梗阻影响治疗安全。
feedback.en: Infection and obstruction affect treatment safety.

text.zh-CN: 仅因局部晚期而宣告没有任何治疗目标
text.en: Declare no treatment goal solely because disease is locally advanced

feedback.zh-CN: 没有明确远处转移时仍需完整多学科评估。
feedback.en: Absence of definite distant spread warrants full multidisciplinary assessment.

prompt.zh-CN: 术后病理完全缓解意味着什么？
prompt.en: What does postoperative pathological complete response mean?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 它是切除标本的结果，不能倒推术前已具备免手术观察条件或永久治愈
text.en: It describes the resection specimen and does not retrospectively establish eligibility for nonoperative observation or permanent cure

feedback.zh-CN: 临床完全缓解、病理完全缓解和长期无复发不是同一概念。
feedback.en: Clinical complete response, pathological complete response and lasting disease freedom are distinct.

text.zh-CN: 病理完全缓解证明所有T4b患者均应免手术
text.en: Pathological complete response means everyT4b patient should avoid surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 需要前瞻性完整评估和严格随访，不能由事后标本泛化。
feedback.en: Selection and intensive follow-up cannot be inferred from a later specimen.

text.zh-CN: 0/22淋巴结即证明无需任何随访
text.en: 0/22 nodes means no follow-up is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 仍需肿瘤随访和个体化后续计划。
feedback.en: Oncological surveillance and an individual plan remain necessary.

conclusion.zh-CN: 局部进展直肠腺癌形成膀胱瘘，经转流和多学科分阶段治疗达到切除标本病理完全缓解。
conclusion.en: Locally advanced rectal adenocarcinoma with a bladder fistula achieved pathological complete response after diversion and staged multidisciplinary treatment.
